name: search_vercel_documentation
description: Search Vercel's published documentation for a topic and return relevant excerpts. Covers Vercel platform features, configuration, APIs, limits, and pricing, including projects and deployments, Git integration, environments, Functions and Fluid Compute, Routing Middleware, Cron Jobs, Sandbox, caching and the CDN, AI SDK and AI Gateway, Firewall and BotID, and storage such as Blob and Edge Config. Results come from a third-party documentation index (Context7). Does not access the user's Vercel account or projects.

tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to include in the result. Default is 2500.

topic.description: Topic to focus the documentation search on (e.g., 'routing', 'data-fetching').
